annotations.title: OCR (image or scanned PDF to text)

description: Read the text in an image (PNG, JPEG, WebP, TIFF incl. multi-page, GIF, AVIF) or a scanned PDF with Tesseract (tesseract.js), fully offline: the English and Arabic models ship with the server and nothing is downloaded or uploaded. Languages: "eng", "ara" or "eng+ara" (default). PDF pages are rendered at 200 dpi by default. Returns the text per page and the mean word confidence (0-100); give "output" to also write a .txt file. Limits: up to 200 pages per call, roughly 1-5 s per page; printed text works well, handwriting and very small or skewed text poorly. For PDFs that already have a text layer, pdf_to_text is faster and exact. Give "file" as a local path or base64.

dpi.description: Render resolution for PDF pages. Default 200.

file.description: The image or PDF: a local file path (absolute, or relative to the server's --root) or base64 data (raw or a data: URI).

maxChars.description: Cut the inline text after this many characters (the file is never cut).

output.description: Also write the text to this .txt file (or folder ending in "/").

pages.description: PDF pages / TIFF frames, e.g. "1-3, 5" (default all).

perPage.description: Also return the text of each page separately in "pages". Default false (the joined "text" has page separators).

psm.description: Page layout: "auto" (default), "block" (one uniform block), "line", "word", or "sparse" (scattered text).

name: ai_ocr
